name: Article 15, § 6 – 19
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text: 6. Where Union support is provided in the form of a grant, EU institutions, bodies, offices or agencies as well as granting authorities shall enjoy upon request royalty-free access rights to results, without impacting the ownership of results, including IPRs on background information, for the only purpose of developing, implementing and monitoring existing Union policies or programmes in the fields of its competence and the right to grant, provided that such access is strictly necessary for those purposes and does not prejudice intellectual property rights, commercially sensitive information or the essential security interests of a Member State. Such access shall not include background information or know-how not generated by the action unless strictly necessary for the use of the results and expressly agreed by the holder of the relevant rights. Access rights granted under the Programme should remain proportionate to its objectives and should not result in the unintended disclosure or transfer of pre-existing know-how, commercially sensitive information or information affecting the essential security interests of Member States.
